experiment_observation.result: dimension-specific self-gap passes continue producing new categories across mature and emerging value-chain nodes
experiment_observation.implication: one-shot or one-corrective-pass recall materially under-extracts latent model knowledge
experiment_observation.stop_rule: seal only after three consecutive low-novelty batches for a shard plus completed gap matrix

cross_chain_schema_findings: capacity must separate nameplate, technically available, product-qualified, customer-qualified, economically operable, operating and actual output
capacity compatibility across chemistry/application/product formats is graded and needs conversion time/cost/requalification, not a boolean
price series require product/spec, delivery boundary, contract/spot status and pricing-lag dimensions
inventory must preserve physical chain location and WIP stage
demand must distinguish sales flow from installed-base replacement demand and preserve unit-intensity vintages
entity hierarchy and aliases must preserve owner/company/project/facility/phase/line/product relationships
technology adoption must preserve announcement, pilot, sample, qualification, SOP, mass production and realized share

next_experiment.goal: measure marginal novelty decay after excluding categories already covered in batch1

self_verification_policy: fresh web search remains forbidden until a shard is sealed
